items.body: M3 committed-provenance standard-library verification. If Run role is work, only in the daemon-assigned disposable worktree create harmless tracked `tests/fixtures/native_canary_m3_45.py` and `tests/test_native_canary_m3_45.py`. The test must use only the Python standard library and be runnable exactly as `python3 tests/test_native_canary_m3_45.py`; run that command. Create regular JSON evidence files `.drover-native-canary/m3-45-analysis.json`, `.drover-native-canary/m3-45-implementation.json`, `.drover-native-canary/m3-45-focused-tests.json`, and `.drover-native-canary/source-task-45.json` identifying candidate 45 and phase m3-stdlib-provenance. Before `drover_work_update(action=complete)`, commit exactly those harmless source/test/evidence files on this assigned session branch, using `git add -f` for the ignored `.drover-native-canary` evidence files. Invoke complete without optional `evidence_key` or `estimated_cost`; record the resulting 40-character HEAD in the final state line. If Run role is verify, do not create or alter any artifact: inspect the already committed files in the assigned verifier worktree, confirm its HEAD contains them, and rerun exactly `python3 tests/test_native_canary_m3_45.py`. Missing, changed, or untracked-only evidence is a verification failure. Do not modify configuration, credentials, network resources, or external services.
